purpose: Scenario descriptions and independent expectations only; not a canonical schema, adapter contract, native document fixture, executable harness or qualification result.
authority: Current product principles, restart plan and metadata-only recipe. Every new architecture decision requires explicit user approval.

current_scope.code_execution_requirement: The user explicitly approved that School-OS agents must be able to execute code. This does not require a dedicated personal machine, persistent process or coding CLI.
current_scope.supplier_availability_report: The user reports confirmation of code execution from all major personal-agent suppliers. This report has not been independently qualified in these fixtures or this documentation update.
current_scope.code_execution_approval_limit: No programming language, Python dependency/version, network access, SDK, adapter contract or full D3 architecture is approved by the code-execution requirement.
current_scope.deferred_post_mvp: The user skipped D2 review and excluded recovery of interrupted canonical writes from the MVP. S13 and S12's interrupted-write recovery branch are retained as future prepared scenarios, not failed or missing MVP functionality.
current_scope.still_applicable: Normal verified persistence and privacy, metadata identity, bounded discovery and continuation from saved window progress, normal fresh-agent queries, and the approved S30–S31 query-coverage rule remain applicable.
current_scope.separate_pending_decisions: D6 external-effect handling and D8 upgrade behavior are not deferred by skipping D2. D2 record-schema choices remain unresolved; no alternative persistence mechanism has been approved. The remainder of D3 and D4–D8 keep their separate pending architecture status.
current_scope.interpretation_of_continuation: Unless a case is explicitly retained as deferred canonical-write recovery, continuation starts from normally verified saved records; it does not promise to reconcile an interrupted canonical write.

fictional_notice: Every person, institution, mailbox, communication, job, output and event below is invented. example.org is used only for fictional addresses. Source-card labels are test references, not canonical record IDs or provider handles.
separation_rules: Keep logical labels, expectations and scenario explanations hidden from any later blind interpreting agent.
Supply only source metadata to an identity operation. Source-content surrogates and semantic expectations cannot resolve identity or thread association.
Keep access aids outside allowed identity evidence; varying or removing them must not alter an otherwise supported logical association.
A future semantic trial must bind independently retained expectations to the exact input packet and ordered content segments before use. No hashes or bindings have been computed here.
No executable tests, simulations, scripts, builds, probes, scheduled jobs, live source reads or external effects were performed to prepare this inventory.

scenarios.title: Install a supplied package and start from Drive
given: A wholly fictional empty private instance and a user-supplied packaged release.
Two separately verified logical mailboxes and the school/date scope chosen by the fictional parent.
A managed agent able to execute code within its temporary environment, with no dedicated personal machine, daemon or coding CLI required.
events: Read the approved package instructions and discover actual capabilities.
Create the approved instance entry point and configuration only if authorized and supported.
End the session, then start a new capable agent from the durable Drive entry point.
independent_expectations: The fresh agent finds the pinned instructions, configured scope, selected operation and unfinished work from Drive.
Private configuration stays separate from reusable package content and raw email/attachments remain at source.
No provider handle, previous conversation or local file is required for canonical startup.
The agent meets the approved code-execution prerequisite; neither a registered connection nor the user's supplier-availability report independently qualifies its runtime operations.
Do not infer a programming language, Python version/dependency, network access, SDK or adapter contract from the code-execution requirement.
approval_dependencies: Drive layout, canonical startup/configuration schema, package admission and installation contract, runtime dependencies

scenarios.title: Capabilities are incomplete or approval-dependent
given: Reader A can execute code, read Drive knowledge and list message summaries but cannot obtain an individual original Date.
Reader B can execute code and access individual metadata but cannot read meaningful images.
Writer C can execute code and exposes Drive writes that require a human approval unavailable to a scheduled run.
In one separate focused branch, Agent D can read displayed text but has no capability to execute code.
events: Each agent selects an operation and inspects its available capabilities.
Attempt only operations whose actual capabilities and authorization suffice.
independent_expectations: Reader A can answer supported knowledge queries but keeps insufficient source associations pending.
Reader B retains visual-content gaps while making useful supported progress.
Writer C never claims it saved a Drive checkpoint when the write was unavailable.

Agent D does not meet the approved School-OS code-execution prerequisite; report that capability mismatch without claiming a supported no-code operating route or adding a required personal machine/process/CLI.
Capability status and verification freshness are scoped to the exact runtime/connection/surface; the user's reported supplier confirmation is not independent operation qualification.
Code execution alone does not establish a selected language, Python dependency/version, network or SDK support, or adapter conformance.
approval_dependencies: Capability vocabulary, adapter contracts and approved handling when canonical writes are unavailable

events: Observe A, then B through a replacement access route, then A again.

Address presentation, domain case, recipient ordering, subject outer whitespace and equivalent known zones are normalized as approved.

scenarios.title: Comparable metadata distinguishes near neighbors
given: The source card mail-trip supplies the baseline and the relevant index lookup is complete.
Each listed variant is a separately labeled fictional logical email; only the stated field changes.

independent_expectations: Do not associate a contradicted variant with the baseline logical record merely because other fields agree.
Do not lowercase local parts, erase plus tags/dots, collapse meaningful subject text, exchange recipient roles or combine source accounts.
A new School-OS record requires adequate metadata and the completed relevant lookup; a variant label itself is not matcher evidence.
Keep each source's provenance without deciding cross-mailbox canonical-task equivalence from metadata alone.

scenarios.title: Indistinguishable metadata is an explicit information limit
given: World R contains two observations of one logical email.
World D stipulates two genuinely different logical emails whose permitted source metadata is exactly the same as World R.
Each world's second observation faces one supported existing record and no contradictory source metadata; no existing duplicate catalog record is seeded.
events: Apply the same approved metadata-only recipe in both worlds.
independent_expectations: The indistinguishable metadata produces the same association policy outcome in both worlds.
World R should reuse its logical record. World D illustrates the accepted residual limitation rather than a reason to inspect content or promote access handles to identity.
Do not promise zero identity errors or score the policy by the number of provider entries.
Do not transfer content-processing completion solely because metadata matches.
Do not cite this fictional World D as evidence that the live Gmail study observed distinct logical-email loss.
scenarios.grading_disposition: Report policy behavior and stipulated indistinguishability separately; no impossible disambiguation pass criterion.

scenarios.title: Existing duplicates and incomplete candidate lookup stay unresolved
given: Two existing School-OS records each have knowledge and supported metadata compatible with a new observation.
In a separate branch of the scenario, the relevant candidate lookup stops early because of its budget.
events: Present candidate records in opposite orders.
Attempt association after the incomplete lookup.
independent_expectations: Do not select the first compatible existing record, silently merge/delete either record or erase their prior knowledge.
Persist a scoped unresolved association using the approved representation.
An incomplete lookup cannot establish absence and cannot by itself justify a new logical email.
Continue unrelated supported work within the run budget.

Explicit empty, partial and missing metadata remain distinguishable.
Generated download filenames and incompatible inline/named inventories do not manufacture contradictions.

scenarios.title: Temporary source custody ends after verified persistence

scope_classification.normal_path: In scope: normal verified persistence, honest incomplete status and temporary-copy cleanup safeguards.
scope_classification.early_loss_recovery_branch: POST-MVP/DEFERRED: recovery/refetch/reconciliation after the canonical write was interrupted by loss of the temporary environment. Preserve the original branch and proposed recovery expectations as future evidence; absence of this capability is not an MVP failure.
scope_classification.continuing_safeguard: Do not claim an unverified write or unread material complete, even when interrupted-write recovery is outside the MVP.

events: Obtain a temporary body/attachment copy for authorized substantive processing.
Persist the source reference, handbook facts, coverage and remaining work using the approved Drive contract.
Read back each required result, then discard accessible temporary source material.
In another branch, one required knowledge write cannot be verified before the temporary environment disappears.
independent_expectations: The body establishes term-wide applicability and page references; the attachment supplies the actual absence/pickup rules.
Verified canonical knowledge remains available without maintaining a raw-source archive on Drive.
Do not intentionally discard the only processing copy on a successful path before required persistence is verified.
If the environment loses the copy early, do not claim completion; retain durable known unfinished work and refetch from source when supported.
Cleanup refers to accessible working copies, not unsupported guarantees about external histories or backups.

scenarios.title: Interrupt every relevant persistence boundary
scenarios.scope_classification: POST-MVP/DEFERRED — interrupted canonical-write recovery was explicitly excluded from the MVP. All original interruption stimuli and proposed recovery expectations are retained for future work; not failed or missing MVP functionality.
scenarios.scope_note: Normal readback verification and honest incomplete-status safeguards remain applicable outside this deferred recovery trial. This case does not classify task-app, email, audio or scheduler effects, whose D6 handling remains separately pending.
interruptions: After the source index but before substantive knowledge
After some knowledge but before canonical task work
After task content but before coverage/unfinished-work confirmation
After a provider accepted a write but before its response reached the agent
After readback exposes a contradictory or missing value
independent_expectations: A fresh agent determines accepted and unfinished work from the approved Drive records.
Index presence does not imply full knowledge, task or attachment completion.
A missing response remains unknown until the approved reconciliation procedure supplies evidence; do not blindly duplicate effects.
Mismatched readback is not accepted as verified persistence.
Source, knowledge, task, coverage and unfinished-work boundaries each receive evidence; one source readback cannot stand in for all of them.
No local journal, provider token or previous conversation is required for critical instance recovery.
approval_dependencies: Exact canonical persistence ordering, verification and recovery contract

scenarios.title: Growing history does not make startup or work unbounded

events: Start a routine operation and a targeted handbook query.

scenarios.title: An unread email may contain tomorrow's required action
given: The query occurs on September 6, 2031 in America/Los_Angeles: What do I need to do for school tomorrow, September 7?
Verified processed knowledge contains the informational library notice and no known September 7 action.

Discovery coverage exposes mail-tomorrow-unread within the configured school scope, but its body has not been processed. The answering agent can see its neutral subject and unread status, not its source-card content.
events: Read verified knowledge and the relevant discovery/processing coverage before answering.
In branch A, authorization or the available budget does not permit completing the missing processing.
In branch B, the existing authorized scope, capabilities and budget permit processing that email, persisting its substantive information and checking the remaining query-scope coverage.
independent_expectations: Do not conclude there are no school tasks tomorrow from the empty known-task result.
Do not assume the unread email is irrelevant from its neutral subject or its absence from the knowledge query hits.

In branch A, explain that no September 7 action is currently verified in the processed knowledge and that the unread school email prevents a complete answer; do not reveal the hidden contact request as known.

In branch B, after verified authorized processing, identify the required phone-number reply to the school office by 08:30 school time on September 7, including that a reply is required even when the number is unchanged, with source provenance.
An exhaustive answer in branch B additionally requires established discovery and processing completeness for the declared query scope; processing this single email alone does not establish that.
Do not exceed authorized scope/budgets, send the reply, or perform another external effect merely to answer the query.
scenarios.approval_basis: The user explicitly approved checking discovery/processing coverage alongside knowledge, bounded authorized completion of missing processing, and limited answers when coverage is incomplete.
approval_dependencies: The accepted query rule remains applicable. D2 record-schema choices are unresolved after skipped review and interrupted canonical-write recovery is deferred outside the MVP. D3's code-execution prerequisite is approved; the remainder of D3 and D4–D8 remain separately pending. No alternative persistence mechanism is approved.

scenarios.title: A bounded coverage lookup cannot establish query completeness
given: A fresh capable agent is asked on September 6, 2031: List all remaining school actions due September 7; if there are none, say so.
The bounded verified-knowledge read returns museum consent due September 10 and the pickup survey due September 11, and no September 7 action.

The approved bounded coverage access route reaches its authorized budget before it can establish discovery and processing completeness for the question's scope. The returned portion has no known gaps, but additional relevant coverage remains unexamined.
The independent fixture includes the unprocessed contact-request email; its presence/content is not exposed to the answering agent by the unfinished coverage lookup.
events: Inspect the returned knowledge and coverage without extending the budget.
Answer at that boundary, retaining only the knowledge and coverage claims actually established.
A later separately authorized continuation may finish the bounded lookup and supported processing, after which the answer must be reassessed from the resulting evidence.
independent_expectations: An absence of gaps in the retrieved portion is not proof that the complete applicable coverage has no gaps.
An empty September 7 task result does not justify saying no actions are due, no relevant emails exist, or the returned list is exhaustive.
State that the bounded lookup could not establish complete discovery/processing coverage, so the answer is limited to verified knowledge examined so far.
Do not invent the hidden email, its action or its exact count to explain the limitation; distinguish unknown completeness from an actually observed unread item.
Stop within the authorized budget and leave or report the remaining coverage work through the approved procedure; do not require an unbounded history scan.
After a later authorized continuation, claim completeness only if the evidence for the declared scope establishes it, and otherwise preserve the limitation.
scenarios.approval_basis: The user explicitly approved limited answers when discovery/processing coverage cannot establish completeness, including bounded lookup limits.
approval_dependencies: No new completeness flag, coverage-index schema, lookup algorithm, budget value or continuation-persistence contract is adopted. D1 and the query-coverage rule remain approved; D2 record-schema choices are unresolved and interrupted canonical-write recovery is deferred outside the MVP. D3's code-execution prerequisite is approved; the remainder of D3 and D4–D8 remain separately pending.
